name: Lasso
tagline: Herd black and white sheep with your dog, then rope one color at a time.
description: Your finger is a sheepdog and the flock runs from it. Push the white sheep away from the black ones, then draw a rope loop around a single color to pen them. Each day is a short round with a goal before sunset, and every day adds a new twist: rams, lambs, mud, a wolf and dusk.

build.notes: First playtest build: six days that each add one twist, then remix days that combine them.

what_to_test.title: Herding feel
what_to_test.details: Does pushing sheep with the dog feel controllable, or do they scatter randomly?

what_to_test.title: Drawing the rope
what_to_test.details: Is it clear how to close a loop? Tell us if loops failed when you thought they should work.

what_to_test.title: Which day is the wall?
what_to_test.details: Note the first day you had to retry and what beat you: time, the field filling up, or a twist.

known_issues: Placeholder art and sound: shapes and synthesized tones only.
Revive and ad-break buttons are stand-ins. No real ads play.
Progress is saved in this browser only.
Day goals have not been tuned against real play yet.
On iPhone, sound stays muted while the silent switch is on.
